scope: Independent UGO benchmark using the final 74 paper entries with explicitly accepted dataset approximations; not exact author-data reproduction.
authorization: User accepted the 18 collected candidate variants even when they differ from the paper.
preprocessing_policy: Existing FoldPreprocessor: fit numeric median imputation, categorical encoding, within-class variance filtering and scaling on training folds only. Engineering conventions; author choices unconfirmed.
evaluation_policy: Recorded stratified ten-fold independent approximation; no author folds. Resampling and model fitting must use only training data.
